feeds.title: The Haverhill Gazette
feeds.description: The Haverhill Gazette (est.1821) is a weekly newspaper in Massachusetts, owned by Community Newspaper Holdings Inc. of Montgomery, Alabama.

feeds.title: The Eagle-Tribune » Haverhill
feeds.description: The two-time Pulitzer Prize-winning Eagle-Tribune covers the Merrimack Valley of Massachusetts and southern New Hampshire. Find news stories from the Haverhill edition.
